rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Validates content authenticity against the official C2PA trust list and Interim Trust List. Fetches trust anchors at startup to ensure trust decisions are always current. Provides tools to read credentials from local files or URLs, returning manifest data with verification status. Supports content signed before and after January 2026 through dual trust list validation.
